action_timeline.rationale: Earlier central rescue; revised position excludes Friston from an Ansel-centered artillery splash.
After officer #9 and roadblock #4 clearance; living refund7 funds the fusion.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Spot occupies the cleared lower-outer lane after living Melantha withdraws.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An opening death or unfinished handoff removes income, containment or civilian clearance; later healing cannot repair an already leaked enemy.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four interceptions and preserve the first medical chain.
handoff_requirements: Observe officer #9 death, roadblock #4 destruction and an empty Melantha block list before 2010.
Credit refund7 only for living withdrawal; Spot deployment must be affordable.
responsibilities: Fang and Friston contain central routes; Midnight and Melantha contain the outer routes.
Ansel begins central healing at 1321; Hibiscus follows at 1681.
Melantha finishes officer #9 and roadblock #4 before withdrawal.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with DP10 and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: Fang survives the grants funding 571 and 1321.
Ansel's first healing reaches Friston before officer pressure exhausts his remaining HP.
Opening Melantha survives without assuming ordinary healing from the revised Ansel position.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery is dead, with Steward and the central formation still available.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A medic or Steward death reopens artillery and approach damage, endangering both civilians and late central capacity.
battle_phases.goal: Keep the artillery damage team and all four lanes alive.
handoff_requirements: Keep Friston alive beyond the previous 2111 break and observe lower officer #11 being blocked.
Do not treat one survived artillery hit as proof of the entire medical chain.
responsibilities: Steward attacks artillery from 2341 without manual target ordering.
Spot heals Ansel during 2462–3212; both principal medics cover Steward.
Hibiscus boosts at 3301 to bridge into Ansel's 3873 boost.
Ansel's extended range restores Midnight during available healing selections.
battle_phases.start_condition: Spot is deployed and Ansel's first boost is ready.
survival_dependencies: Ansel and Steward may each take a full splash hit from one projectile.
Normal healing during Hibiscus's own exposure must preserve her until the bridge boost.
Artillery must die before its later protected-target exposure becomes lethal; baseline kill frame 4273 is not promised after the changed deployment.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Final spawns are consumed, final approaches are finished and every remaining hostile is contained.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A released armor or thrower leaks before western clearance; subsequent device destruction cannot restore project acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Remove central armor and paired throwers without overflowing blockers.
handoff_requirements: Observe armor #34 blocked at the lower-central holder and damaged sufficiently for eventual death.
Steward's 7000 withdrawal transfers only residual damage duty, never his blockers' containment duty.
responsibilities: Melantha attacks Friston's held enemies, using 5342 for early lower armor and throwers.
Midnight uses 5073 arts while retaining upper-outer blocking.
Spot holds delayed outer officers, including up to three while healing.
battle_phases.start_condition: Melantha returns at 4141 and central armored pressure is approaching.
survival_dependencies: Friston retains three blocks and principal medical coverage.
Upper armor dies before paired upper throwers exceed Fang's capacity.
Spot's loss of attacks during healing is included in queue duration; no dodge talent is assumed.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Residual hostiles are dead and roadblock #1 is destroyed.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Premature blocker withdrawal releases enemies; an uncleared upper restraint prevents the required safe arrival.
battle_phases.goal: Finish held enemies and release the upper civilian safely.
handoff_requirements: Do not release Fang at 10800 unless upper-central hostile clearance has occurred.
responsibilities: Melantha's 7143 boost and Midnight's 8374 arts finish residual central enemies.
Spot retains lower officers until their deaths.
Steward returns at 9101 to clear roadblock #1.
battle_phases.start_condition: Steward has withdrawn after final approach fire.
survival_dependencies: Blockers remain deployed until their actual queues are empty.
The waiting upper civilian remains separated from surviving officers and artillery is already dead.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both protected targets have reached, no protected target died, no enemy leaked, all spawns are exhausted, no active enemies remain and life is positive.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Missing arrival, protected-target death, remaining enemy or any leak makes the project unsuccessful.
battle_phases.goal: Complete lower evacuation and verify full-stage acceptance.
handoff_requirements: Observe both distinct protected-target arrival events.
Record operator deaths separately; any useful death still requires its lost duties and replacement costs to be resolved.
responsibilities: Fang returns at 12901 facing LEFT to destroy roadblock #2.
Retain any still-needed outer blocker until its enemies die.
Observe objective events rather than inferring success from elapsed time.
battle_phases.start_condition: Fang is released from an empty upper-central lane at 10800.
survival_dependencies: The lower civilian remains safe while restrained; all hostile access to it is closed.
Fang survives, completes cooldown and pays10 for clearance.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward kills artillery; Spot and both medics preserve its required damage window. Do not substitute a predicted cooldown bait for the kill.
Midnight clears roadblock #3 and intercepts upper-outer officers; returning Steward clears roadblock #1. Keep officers away from the waiting protected target.
Opening Melantha clears roadblock #4; Spot contains subsequent officers; returning Fang clears roadblock #2.
Fang blocks; Midnight supplies crossfire and arts; Steward damages approaches. Clear upper armor before paired throwers exceed Fang's two-block capacity.
Friston blocks throughout. Midnight, returning Melantha and Steward's approach fire must remove earlier occupants before armor #34 arrives.
Midnight blocks upper-outer traffic. His self-blocked enemies reduce central assistance; extended Ansel healing replaces Lancet's former recovery.
Melantha handles the first thrower and officer; Spot receives later enemies at their original crossing, with no released enemy assumed to be recaptured.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Upper-central containment and conditional opening income.
Upper-outer interception, roadblock #3 and central crossfire.
Central healing, Steward support and periodic extended-range Midnight recovery.
Heal Fang, Friston, Ansel, Steward and herself.
Permanent lower-outer three-block holder; skill heals adjacent Ansel and himself.
Artillery removal and central approach damage through frame 7000.
Damage enemies held by Friston after redeployment.

formation_structure.artillery_geometry: Ansel [5,6] is sqrt(2) from Friston [4,5] and opening Melantha [6,5], outside the current artillery splash radius 1.2. Steward [5,7] is only one tile from Ansel and therefore shares splash. That shared exposure is explicitly assigned to Spot plus both medics.
formation_structure.capacity: Exactly eight distinct catalog IDs; peak simultaneous deployment is eight, without relying on robot deployment exemptions.
formation_structure.central_damage: Midnight retains upper-central and lower-central crossfire. Returning Melantha retains direct lower-central damage. Steward retains approach fire through the final armor arrival; his eastern range does not include an enemy settled at [4,5].

economy.basis: Initial DP10, natural +1/s, Fang's living grants at 570/1320/2070, and Melantha's actual living refund7 at 2010. No later Fang grants are needed for the conservative ledger.
economy.late_costs: Current inspected executor charges base deployment cost on redeployment: Melantha15, Steward18 and Fang10. Steward and Fang withdrawals refund9 and5 respectively, subject to the DP cap; late purchases remain affordable without those refunds.

formation_structure.opening_reconstruction: The first four placements retain the M52 interception geometry. Ansel replaces the first medical deployment at 1321; Hibiscus follows at 1681. Ansel normally covers [3,5], [4,5], [2,6] and [5,7].
formation_structure.spot_fusion: Spot [6,5] covers Ansel [5,6] with his nine-cell healing skill. He does not heal Friston, Fang or Steward directly. Healing stops his damage but preserves three-block containment.
formation_structure.upper_medical_replacement: Without Lancet, Midnight depends on Ansel's extended DOWN range during 2072–2822, 3873–4623 and 5674–6424. Ordinary Ansel and Hibiscus ranges exclude Midnight. Actual lowest-HP-ratio selection must provide recovery; no recipient command or extra-heal talent is assumed.

formation_transitions.transition: Ansel begins central rescue before officer #7; this replaces the unsupported assumption that Friston survives until later medicine.
Withdraw Melantha only after her opening enemies and roadblock #4 are cleared; forecast lane empty, with no wounded-enemy transfer.
Spot occupies the vacated lower-outer tile before the next officers.
Spot's first healing window supports Ansel during the initial shared medic–caster barrage.
Hibiscus's deliberately delayed first boost bridges the subsequent barrage into Ansel's second boost.
Melantha returns beside Friston after 2131 frames of redeployment recovery.
Steward leaves only after final approaches; surviving settled enemies remain assigned to their blockers and central damage units.
Steward returns after 2101 frames to clear roadblock #1.
Fang leaves after upper-central clearance, preparing western lower clearance.
Fang returns after 2101 frames to clear roadblock #2.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: The selected roster and all operational DEPLOY actions contain exactly these eight normal-mode rarity 1–3 IDs; no hidden substitute or reserve unit.
All DEPLOY tiles are integer [row,col] with explicit facing. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Melantha must remain through officer #9 death and roadblock #4 destruction. Her retreat releases no enemy; Spot's later blocks must be observed independently.
Friston survives beyond 2111; both medics and Steward survive their assigned barrage. Spot cannot directly heal Steward, and the shared Ansel–Steward splash must be counted twice.
Ansel's extended-range windows must actually restore Midnight before repeated outer pressure exhausts him; coverage alone is not proof of healing.
Retain Friston's lower-central three blocks and Fang's upper-central two blocks until their enemies die. Armor #34 must receive a BLOCK and sufficient damage, not merely approach hits.

Issue skills and withdrawals only to deployed living units. A failed survival or clearance precondition invalidates this fixed continuation; do not send dead-state commands or fabricate an immediate replacement.
Melantha, Steward and Fang must complete their real cooldowns and pay deployment costs. Withdrawal refunds are credited only when alive; death provides no refund.
Ordinary operators neither attack, block nor heal civilians. Officers remain dangerous within 1.2; no bait is assumed to override protected-target priority.

Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and both expected protected targets reaching their objectives. Operator deaths are assessed separately by lost contribution and replacement cost.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Preserve four opening interceptions, Fang income, early Friston medicine and both eastern clearance owners. Complete Melantha's actual duties before withdrawing.
Keep Ansel and Steward alive through shared splash using Spot's first skill, Ansel's first two boosts and Hibiscus's bridge window; restore Midnight during extended range.
Kill artillery before protected-target lethal exposure; Melantha and Midnight clear early armor while Spot holds his delayed outer queue.
Contain paired throwers and armor #34; retain eastern Steward until 7000, then finish held enemies with Melantha and Midnight. Spot may hold three officers while healing.
Finish residual hostiles, clear both western roadblocks and observe both safe arrivals. Frame 18000 is an observation allowance, not a success condition.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic income requires living deployment; only grants 570/1320/2070 fund the opening ledger.
Opening clearance, late armor/thrower arts and residual armor closure; retain 40-second effects and inactive-only SP recovery.
Boost covered healing and extend DOWN coverage to Midnight. Recipient selection remains automatic; no extra-heal talent is credited.
First boost bridges approximately 110–130 seconds into Ansel's second boost; later boosts support central armor and thrower pressure. Readiness at 2581 does not require immediate activation.
Heal Ansel and self while retaining three blocks. First window uses the empty outer interval; subsequent windows trade damage for recovery and can leave a three-officer queue.
Accelerate lower armor and thrower clearance, then finish residual lower armor while Friston retains blocking.
Ordinary arts and supported automatic attack-SP strikes kill artillery and damage final approaches; western redeployment attacks roadblock #1.
Permanent ordinary blocking; no unsupported deployment protection or talent is credited.

tactical_thesis: Replace Beagle with Spot and remove Lancet. Restore Midnight to upper-outer interception and Melantha to opening lower-outer clearance. Deploy Ansel first at [5,6] DOWN: he covers both central blockers while his artillery impact point excludes Friston and opening Melantha. Keep Melantha through officer #9 and roadblock #4 clearance, then withdraw alive and deploy Spot into an empty lane. Spot combines lower-outer blocking with healing Ansel during shared Ansel–Steward splash exposure. Retain Melantha's central return and Steward's final approach fire so artillery, both late central queues, armor #34 and all four roadblocks retain explicit owners. This is a statically checked, unexecuted hypothesis.
